prompt:
You are a senior typographer and information designer. You lay out data tables for publication. You judge layouts by looking at the rendered result as a whole: what the table is for, how a reader scans and compares it, which columns belong together or play the same role, proportion and rhythm across columns, a clear hierarchy of headers and groups, whether rows read as units, whether words, numbers and identifiers stay intact, and how text and white space are distributed. Fewer lines or a shorter table is not automatically better, and neither is equal widths or symmetry; decide case by case and say why.

Table: 组件版本兼容矩阵 (language zh-CN).
Grid: 5 columns × 8 rows. Row headers: yes (first logical column identifies each row).
Per-column content facts (content px at 15px font, excluding padding):
  col 1: header "组件" · longest unbreakable word 31px · one-line width 112px
  col 2: header "v1.x" · longest unbreakable word 29px · one-line width 62px
  col 3: header "v2.x" · longest unbreakable word 31px · one-line width 62px
  col 4: header "v3.x" · longest unbreakable word 31px · one-line width 62px
  col 5: header "说明" · longest unbreakable word 171px · one-line width 494px
Each column also has 21px of padding+border, so a column given width w px shows w−21 px of text.
Available width: 360px (the dashed pink box = the reader's viewport). The column widths you choose must sum to at most 359px.
This table cannot fit without splitting words at 360px. You MAY choose a total wider than 359px (the reader then scrolls horizontally), or squeeze and accept splits — a design decision.
Rendering convention: the screenshot always shows the WHOLE table. Anything beyond the dashed box is not clipped; it is the part a reader reaches by scrolling sideways, so judge both what fits in the box at first sight and the cost of scrolling to the rest.
Fixed: content, font, 15px font size, padding, borders, colours, alignment. You control ONLY the column widths.

Your understanding so far: {"purpose":"展示各组件在 v1.x、v2.x 和 v3.x 中的支持情况及相关限制，帮助读者判断版本兼容性。","reading":"读者先按组件定位行，再横向比较三个版本的状态，最后查看说明中的条件或例外。","groups":["v1.x、v2.x、v3.x 是并列的状态列，应保持一致的宽度，便于逐列比较。","组件与三个版本状态共同构成主要矩阵；说明列补充每行的兼容条件。"],"keep_intact":["版本标识 v1.x、v2.x、v3.x","支持状态，如“✓ 支持”“× 不支持”“部分支持”","组件名称中的 SDK 等标识，以及说明中的版本号和长标识"],"may_wrap":["组件名称可在自然的词语边界换行。","说明文字可按中文语意换行，并可利用状态较长的行产生的高度。"]}

The first image is the one-line content overview. The other images are real browser renders of your current designs:
Design r1A: widths [95, 83, 83, 83, 192] · table 537×640px · row heights [36, 83, 83, 83, 106, 83, 83, 83] · column headers wrapped 0/5 · tallest cell 4 lines · mid-word splits 0 · OVERFLOWS the box by 177px
Design r1B: widths [83, 75, 75, 75, 192] · table 501×640px · row heights [36, 83, 83, 83, 106, 83, 83, 83] · column headers wrapped 0/5 · tallest cell 4 lines · mid-word splits 0 · OVERFLOWS the box by 141px
Design r1C: widths [70, 75, 75, 75, 192] · table 488×640px · row heights [36, 83, 83, 83, 106, 83, 83, 83] · column headers wrapped 0/5 · tallest cell 4 lines · mid-word splits 0 · OVERFLOWS the box by 128px

Look carefully at each render as a whole and in detail. For each design say what works and what is visually wrong, and WHY it happens (which width causes it). Then propose up to 3 improved designs: refine the most promising, fix the problems you saw, and try a new idea if an important alternative is unexplored. If no design can be meaningfully improved, set "done": true and return no new designs.
Reply ONLY JSON: {"critique":[{"design":"name","good":"","problems":"","cause":""}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"short-name","widths":[int px],"change":"what you changed and why"}]}

log.raw: {"critique":[{"design":"r1A","good":"三个版本列等宽，支持状态保持在一行，便于横向比较；组件名称的换行也较易辨认。说明列有足够宽度容纳长标识。","problems":"初始视口几乎只显示主要矩阵，说明列需要横向滚动才能阅读；组件列仍有一些不自然的换行。","cause":"三个状态列各为83px，加上95px的组件列，使说明列起点落在视口边缘。"},{"design":"r1B","good":"等宽版本列保持了比较节奏；较窄的主要矩阵让说明列有一部分进入初始视口，组件名称仍大致可辨。","problems":"“部分支持”和“× 不支持”等状态被拆成两行，削弱了扫描和跨列比较；说明仍需滚动阅读。","cause":"状态列各为75px，扣除内边距和边框后不足以容纳一行状态；说明列宽192px使总宽仍超过视口。"},{"design":"r1C","good":"总宽是三者中最小的，初始视口能看到更多说明列；三个版本列仍保持等宽。","problems":"状态仍被拆行，多个组件名称也碎成两三行，行首识别变慢；节省的宽度不足以避免横向滚动。","cause":"组件列缩至70px，状态列仍为75px；说明列保持192px，因此总宽仍为488px。"}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"完整状态优先","widths":[83,83,83,83,192],"change":"以r1B的组件列搭配r1A的状态列，恢复状态单行显示，同时比r1A略早露出说明列。"},{"name":"紧凑矩阵","widths":[78,83,83,83,192],"change":"保留完整状态和说明中的长标识，略缩组件列，测试组件名称换行与初始视口空间之间的折中。"},{"name":"更多说明可见","widths":[83,80,80,80,192],"change":"试探略窄的等宽状态列能否仍容纳最长状态，同时让说明列更早进入视口。"}]}
